facebook.caption: POV: you take a random turn off the main road and end up in Rạch Hàm, Phú Quốc. Boats rocking. Nets drying. Zero tour groups. Ham Ninh fishing town is what most tourists drive straight past on the way to the beaches. 4.1 stars from over 1,000 reviews. The locals here are the real deal. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Wooden boats, salt air, and fishermen hauling in the morning catch. Ham Ninh is running at its own pace, and nobody told the tourists. This is what Phu Quoc looks like before the resorts showed up.
